# Theme scope. Eligible minor theme that may be consolidated into a neighbouring loyal theme.
# v15.0 Phase 1: Naval themes are explicitly protected from land-theme consolidation.
oe_t2_can_be_consolidated_recipient = {
    oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
    has_variable = oe_theme_region_id
    NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
    NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes }
}

# Theme scope. Receiving theme may co-administer up to 3 absorbed historical regions (v15.0: < 3).
oe_t2_receiver_under_region_cap = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 }
}

# Theme scope; scope:recipient is the theme being consolidated.
# True when both themes sit in the same or adjacent distance tier from Constantinople.
oe_t2_adjacent_distance_band = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance }
        scope:recipient = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance } }
        AND = {
            var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1
            scope:recipient = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 } }
        }
        AND = {
            var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2
            scope:recipient = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 1 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 } }
        }
        AND = {
            var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3
            scope:recipient = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 2 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
        }
        AND = {
            var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4
            scope:recipient = { OR = { var:oe_theme_distance ?= 3 var:oe_theme_distance ?= 4 } }
        }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Eligible to split off its most recently co-administered historical region (up to 3 slots LIFO).
oe_t2_can_split_theme = {
    oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_3
            var:oe_t2_absorbed_seat_3 ?= { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 }
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_2
            var:oe_t2_absorbed_seat_2 ?= { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 }
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat
            var:oe_t2_absorbed_seat ?= { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
        }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Eligible partner theme for Strategos rotation (must not be recipient or despotate).
oe_t2_rotate_partner_ok = {
    oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
    NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
    NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
    has_ruler = yes
}

# Theme scope; scope:oe_t2_ct is the defiant crisis theme.
# Loyal Army or Frontier theme that may be mobilized to crack down on a defiant neighbour.
oe_t2_loyal_enforcer_trigger = {
    oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
    OR = {
        is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme
        is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier
    }
    OR = {
        var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2
        var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3
    }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
    NOT = { this = scope:oe_t2_ct }
}
